commands.text:
BUILT_VERSION=$(node dist/cli.js --version)
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
if [ "$BUILT_VERSION" != "$PKG_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "Version mismatch: built CLI says $BUILT_VERSION, package.json says $PKG_VERSION"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Built CLI smoke OK: $BUILT_VERSION"

{
  echo "## rig-bridge CI summary"
  echo ""
  if [ -f test-output.log ]; then
    TEST_COUNT=$(grep -oP '\d+(?= passed)' test-output.log | head -1 || echo "n/a")
    echo "- Tests: ${TEST_COUNT} passing"
  else
    echo "- Tests: log not found"
  fi
  AUDIT_JSON=$(npm audit --json 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')
  CRIT=$(echo "$AUDIT_JSON" | jq -r '.metadata.vulnerabilities.critical // 0')
  HIGH=$(echo "$AUDIT_JSON" | jq -r '.metadata.vulnerabilities.high // 0')
  MOD=$(echo "$AUDIT_JSON" | jq -r '.metadata.vulnerabilities.moderate // 0')
  echo "- Audit: ${CRIT} critical / ${HIGH} high / ${MOD} moderate"
  echo "- Node: ${{ matrix.node-version || '20.11.0' }}"
  echo "- OS: ${{ runner.os }}"
} >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
if [ "$TAG" != "$PKG_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match package.json version $PKG_VERSION"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Tag and package.json version match: $PKG_VERSION"

BUILT_VERSION=$(node dist/cli.js --version)
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
if [ "$BUILT_VERSION" != "$PKG_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::Built CLI version $BUILT_VERSION does not match package.json $PKG_VERSION"
  exit 1
fi
